title: Visual editor and Rasenfalcon reference
summary: Live split-screen editor permits original/draft comparison, responsive previews, candidate ZIP export, and explicit native CLI handoff. Fixture javascript is derived from upstream Rasenfalcon website builder; it is not a second publishing authority.
invariants: Generated preview ZIP is CANDIDATE_ONLY; not production deployment.
HTML-like user content rendered safely as text; forbid script execution from content.
The browser never has the NoSQLServer file path, credentials, database handles or public publishing authority.
GitHub source import includes the exact editor HTML/CSS/JS, fixture and tests from v0.3; excludes bundled dependency ZIP and generated preview images.

provenance.claim: Exact complete v0.3 publisher distribution used for source inventory and regression suite
